scope: Admission-linked CHARTTIME measurement-window sensitivity of retrospective recorded-diagnosis classification; not incident MACE, result-available baseline, early warning or external validation
outer_split: StratifiedKFold for one-row-per-patient China; StratifiedGroupKFold for MIMIC
inner_and_calibration_stratification: patient-level any-positive original label, never split a patient
class_weights: fit-role labels only; China RF integer negative/positive ratio as original; MIMIC RF balanced
primary_model: 50:50 XGBoost/RandomForest; select rounds independently inside each window's fixed inner role; refit full outer-training role; raw probability is primary
calibration_models: separate base-fit raw model and Platt-calibrated probabilities; calibration patients excluded from base fit
calibrator: L2 logistic C=1 on clipped probability logit, fit on calibration patients only
comparators: L2 logistic C=1 all original features
L2 logistic C=1 missingness indicators only
preprocessing: China original patient full-record mean and constant-zero imputation; MIMIC fit-role median and fit-role empty-column removal; scaling for logistic fit-role only
bootstrap_unit: patient, retaining all admissions and patient multiplicity for MIMIC
bootstrap_interpretation: percentile 95 percent intervals conditional on fixed out-of-fold predictions, not refitting uncertainty
paired_comparisons: 24h minus 0h, 48h minus 24h, 48h minus 0h separately for retained and excluded-column variants
excluded-column minus retained-column at each window
each window primary minus the previously completed same-fold full-cache patient-isolated primary (reference only)
base Platt minus base raw within each run
primary minus logistic and primary minus age within each run

window_specification.anchor: Original raw ADMISSIONS.ADMITTIME for hospital admission, not ICU INTIME
window_specification.start: Same-admission EDREGTIME when nonmissing and <= ADMITTIME, otherwise ADMITTIME
window_specification.boundary_inclusion: start <= CHARTTIME <= end; invalid or missing required times contribute no laboratory measurement, never change the original label
window_specification.admission_scope: Exactly the original 9946 admissions from 6783 patients and 4462 positive original labels; no discharge-time exclusions in the primary analysis
window_specification.zero_hour: ED-registration-to-hospital-admission measurement proxy where an admissible ED anchor exists; otherwise exact-admission measurements plus original demographics. Not complete admission-time information and not confirmed result availability.
window_specification.aggregation: Preserve original ITEMID-to-Feature mapping and median VALUENUM within each selected window; derive Globulin as median Total Protein minus median Albumin, as original; do not repair units or alter any other input
window_specification.outside_window: Exclude cached pre-ED/no-ED preadmission and post-discharge measurement rows; no arbitrary retrospective lookback
window_specification.availability: CHARTTIME only, not STORETIME or clinician-visible result release
window_specification.onset: No event onset reconstructed and no event-free landmark risk set asserted

frozen_roles: Copy and verify patient_roles.npz from original_v5_independent_validation_v1/private/runs/MIMIC_original; all six runs use these identical roles

secondary_common_subset.definition: DISCHTIME > ADMITTIME + 48h with valid raw timestamps
secondary_common_subset.application: Apply the same subset to every completed OOF prediction array for paired evaluation only; do not retrain or redefine splits
secondary_common_subset.warning: Selected using future stay duration; not an event-free landmark risk set and not a prospective validation cohort

preparation: Preserve original 43 nominal columns and NaN masks; unchanged source Age/Sex_M; fit-role-only median imputation and empty-column handling
